scenes.say: Three website trends every small business should know about in 2026.
One. AI answers come first. Google's AI Overviews and ChatGPT answer questions directly, and they pull that info from websites.
scenes.cap: *AI answers come first.* And they pull from websites.

scenes.say: So give them something to read. Clear service pages, a real FAQ, and hours that are always correct.
Two. Phone first, not just phone friendly. Most local searches happen on a phone, so the call button and booking need to be one tap away.
scenes.cap: Most local searches happen *on a phone.*

scenes.say: Three. People expect instant answers. Online booking and chatbots reply at eleven at night, when you're closed.
